title: [GMCP 203.014.01] Contract: Official Tasks extension and durable long-running work
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-014-01. Translate the mastery target into a normative clause and behavior table. Pin source revisions and hashes; define canonical APIs and data models, compatibility and deprecation decisions, threat model, measurable SLO or resource budgets, positive and negative fixtures, and immutable evidence locations. Resolve every ambiguity before implementation. Vector outcome: The official Tasks extension is implemented on both client and server for get, update, cancel, notifications, state transitions, expiry, retries, ownership and server-directed execution. Durable tasks survive process restart exactly once, compose with MRTR and progress, enforce terminal-state invariants, and reject stale, cross-user, forged or replayed task handles. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
